tutorial.promptDesc: New to Kita? Play a quick interactive tutorial to learn the core rules, or skip straight into the game!
tutorial.makeYourMove: Make your move on the board
tutorial.page1Card1: This is the Kita board shape.
tutorial.page1Card3:
Each side has:
<king_icon/> 1 King
<pawn_icon/> And 2 Pawns
tutorial.page2Card1: Each tile has a value of <yellow>1</yellow>, 2, or 3.
tutorial.page2Card2: Each tile has a value of 1, <yellow>2</yellow>, or 3.
tutorial.page2Card3: Each tile has a value of 1, 2, or <yellow>3</yellow>.
tutorial.page3Card1: The step count you can move equals the value of the opponent's King's tile.
tutorial.page3Card2:
<red>Notice that the Black King sits on a <mint>2-value</mint> tile.</red>

<yellow>Make a move!</yellow>
You <red>cannot</red> <yellow>pass through</yellow> other pieces or <yellow>capture</yellow> the pawns.
tutorial.page3OpponentMoved:
<red>Notice that the Black King now sits on a <mint>{val}-value</mint> tile.</red>

<yellow>Make another move!</yellow>
tutorial.page4Card1:
You cannot undo your previous move by moving the same piece back to where it came from.

Your last move was <red>{lastMove}</red>. Notice you cannot do <red>{reversedMove}</red> now.

<yellow>Make another move!</yellow>
tutorial.page4Success: Great! Notice how returning to where you came from was prohibited.
tutorial.page5Card1: However, if that reversal is your <mint>ONLY</mint> legal move, it is allowed as an exception.
tutorial.page5Success: Forced reversal executed! You were allowed to reverse because no other legal move existed.
tutorial.page6Card1:
You <mint>win</mint> when:
• <yellow>You capture the opponent's King.</yellow>
tutorial.page6Card2:
You <mint>win</mint> when:
• <gray>You capture the opponent's King.</gray>
• <yellow>Your opponent has no legal moves left.</yellow>
tutorial.page6SuccessTrap: Opponent trapped with no legal moves! You win.
tutorial.page7Card1:
When a King is captured, the game is not over immediately!
If the opponent can retaliate and capture your King on their very next turn, the game ends in a <yellow>draw</yellow>.
tutorial.page7Success: Retaliation completed! Both Kings captured, ending in a Draw.
tutorial.page8Card1: A <mint>draw</mint> also occurs if the exact same board position is repeated 3 times, or by mutual agreement.
